title: Jazzy Snappy Spanish Swede Wrap
description: A halal-friendly Andalusian dish featuring swede, wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, with a snappy and herbal flavor profile.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the paprika, cumin, and coriander, and cook for 1 minute until the spices are fragrant.
Add the diced swede and cook for 5 minutes until it starts to soften.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Prepare the collard green leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
Wrap the swede mixture in the collard green leaves, making sure to seal the edges.
Steam the wrapped swede over boiling water for 10 minutes until the leaves are tender.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon juice and a side of your choice.
